storage_identity.node: n: + first24hex(sha256(canonical JSON [occurrence, artifact relative path, exact JSON pointer])) unless explicit proven-definition key applies
storage_identity.edge: e: + first24hex(sha256(canonical JSON [artifact relative path, exact JSON pointer]))
storage_identity.source_occurrence: occ: + first24hex(sha256(canonical JSON [artifact relative path, exact JSON pointer]))
storage_identity.collision_rule: Validate uniqueness in each graph. A truncated-hash collision is an error, never a merge.
storage_identity.graph_revision: Manifest of source artifact hashes plus contract/schema version. Storage ID stability does not establish lifecycle or native revision equivalence.

lifecycle_identity.unknown_policy: No exact join until all members are explicitly known. Preserve source object unchanged.

required: known explicit version/revision with original JSON type
exact semantic body including all AST/order/parameters/controls
definition_equivalence.missing_revision_or_scope: Keep distinct; immutable file bytes alone prove duplicate source content, not the same semantic definition revision.
non_equivalence: same field name across clocks or subjects
same lifecycle ID with different generation

time.availability_cutoff: retain separately from sample, receipt and occurrence time
time.absent_time: explicit missing, never query time or zero

provenance.proof_scope: exact evidence type and record provenance, never source-link shape alone
